artifact_type: bounded source feasibility inventory,not fitted benchmark
question: Can external fusion-junction oligonucleotide studies supply paired fusion and BOTH-parent outcomes,chemistry and negative designs across>=3 target families?
decision_basis: Three siRNA families have some both-parent evidence,not three complete multi-design negative panels. ASO evidence remains separate and insufficient. Absence in inspected sources is not proof of absence in all literature.
missingness_convention: null means no exact numeric value transcribed;status fields distinguish measured figure-only,not reported,not done,inaccessible and uninspected. Controls are not automatically failed junction designs.

search.type: bounded lead-driven primary-source feasibility search,not systematic review
queries_recorded: fusion junction antisense oligonucleotide BCR ABL parent genes negative sequences
"Specific inhibition of bcr-abl gene expression by small interfering RNA"
search.query_log_scope: Principal exact discovery queries;navigation/targeted figure lookup and unsuccessful broad site-filter queries omitted.
search.scope_stop: Named leads plus citation-chain BCR/MLL/FGFR and ASO counterexamples;no outreach,installs,nested dispatch or paid tools.

sources.title: Cancer-Specific Sequences in the Diagnosis and Treatment of NUT Carcinoma
sources.inspected: Main XML; all seven supplemental PDF text; S5 and S6 page 1 visually rendered
sources.adequacy: Not both-parent complete: S5 only WT BRD4; S6 only WT SS18. WT NUTM1 primer is listed in S3 but no outcome series in S5; no WT SSX1 primer in S3.
sources.chemistry: Synthetic duplex RNA, 3-prime dTdT overhangs; additional positional modifications not disclosed. Accell in vivo design #9 is a separate proprietary chemistry stratum.
sources.conditions: 50 nM; 72 h; Neon electroporation; HCC2429 (BRD4-NUTM1) or HS-SY-II (SS18-SSX1).
sources.assay_specificity: Fusion junction qRT-PCR; WT BRD4 and WT SS18 C-terminal primer regions absent from fusion; GUSB reference. No independent primer mapping performed.
sources.uncertainty: Triplicate qPCR; SD. Biological versus technical independence not resolved.
sources.negative_evidence: B4N #6 ineffective protein control; #12/#15 also suppress BRD4; SS #12 transcript/protein discrepancy. S6B caption says #3/#7/#11 attenuate SS18 whereas body describes fusion selectivity for #3/#6/#11; preserve discrepancy.
sources.numeric_availability: Plots/blots, not raw numeric outcome tables; no digitization.

sources.title: Enhancing potency of siRNA targeting fusion genes by optimization outside of target sequence
sources.inspected: Main HTML including inline S1-S3 captions and Methods sequences; external PNAS supplement package not separately retrieved
sources.adequacy: Fusion measurements and potency failures, but no paired WT parent response panel.
pointers: Methods: siRNAs, Quantitative RT-PCR, Western Blotting
sources.chemistry: Dharmacon duplex RNA with optional UU overhangs, terminal mismatches or G-U wobble; these are not gapmer sugar/backbone modifications.
sources.conditions: BCR qPCR: K562,1/10 nM,48 h,X-tremeGENE; BCR protein:1/5 nM,72 h. T/E protein:5 nM,72 h,RNAiMAX,HEK293T ectopic V5-fusion. VCaP viability:1/10/100 nM,72 h.
sources.assay_specificity: BCR b3a2 qPCR. Endogenous ERG and fusion nearly same size; authors used V5-tagged fusion in HEK293T for specific T/E protein assay. Neither ERG sparing nor TMPRSS2 sparing follows.
sources.negative_evidence: Unmodified BCR weak at1 nM; no detectable protein change at1 nM despite mRNA reduction; terminal asymmetry does not improve ectopic T/E protein; high-dose saturation and delivery toxicity retained.
sources.numeric_availability: Figure/blot values; numeric raw outcomes not extracted.

sources.title: Recurrent read-through fusion transcripts in breast cancer
sources.inspected: Main XML and Fig4 caption; XLS supplement identified but not parsed (bundled XLS reader unavailable; no installs)
sources.adequacy: Two active designs; no both-parent outcomes found in inspected main article. Supplement remains uninspected.
sources.chemistry: ON-TARGETplus custom duplexes; terminal phosphorylation shown; proprietary positional chemistry not disclosed.
sources.conditions: MCF7;3 pmol/well;0.3 uL RNAiMAX;96-well;48 h qPCR,72 h proliferation;triplicate transfections.
sources.assay_specificity: Junction-flanking fusion qPCR normalized to CTCF; not parent assays.
sources.negative_evidence: Both reported designs active; mock and nontargeting controls are not failed junction designs.
sources.numeric_availability: Text gives42-51% transcript remaining across two designs, without assigning each value; individual values figure-only.

sources.title: RNAi technology targeting the FGFR3-TACC3 fusion breakpoint: an opportunity for precision medicine
sources.inspected: Main XML; Figures2/3 visually inspected; supplementary DOCX captions/table text inspected, embedded supplementary images not separately rendered
sources.adequacy: Both-parent evidence only for selected #5; parent WT FGFR3 measured in separate overexpression line, not an all-design matched endogenous triple.
sources.chemistry: Custom Dharmacon; Figure2A gives target strings, not complete chemically annotated duplexes. shRNA/siRNA/exosome experiments kept separate.
sources.conditions: 48 h;Lipofectamine2000;25/100/250 pmol for selected #5;SNB19.F3T3 versus SNB19.WT-FGFR3. Panel-screen dose not resolved.
sources.assay_specificity: Fusion-specific and WT-FGFR3 qPCR (regions lost in fusion); WT TACC3 protein blot, not TACC3 mRNA endpoint. FGFR3 N-terminal antibody with constructs/band resolution.
sources.negative_evidence: Ten-design fusion-protein screen includes weak/nondepleting #2/#4; no both-parent follow-up for these. #5 selected for downstream studies.
sources.numeric_availability: Figure-only; supplemental densitometry n=3 independent blots. No raw numeric extraction.

sources.title: Specific inhibition of bcr-abl gene expression by small interfering RNA
sources.inspected: Author-uploaded primary full-text transcription: Methods, Results, Tables1-2, Fig1 caption; publisher PDF403
sources.adequacy: Numeric matched both-parent subset for two selected designs; unsuccessful initial designs unreported, so selection-biased.
sources.chemistry: 21-nt strands,19 RNA bases + dTdT overhangs; BioSpring synthesis.
sources.conditions: 0.5 ug duplex/100 uL;1 million cells;330 V,10 ms electroporation;24 h Table1.
sources.assay_specificity: WT BCR probe spans b5/b6; WT ABL probe spans exon1a/2, separate from b3a2 fusion; GAPDH reference.
sources.negative_evidence: Four designs screened; only b3a2_1/_3 selected and sequenced. Initial screen data not shown. Table2 has functional failure: no significant CML colony inhibition despite fusion reduction.
sources.numeric_availability: Table1 numeric; K562 mean+/-SD,n=4 independent experiments. Patients1-4 parents ND (not done),patients5-6 measured without uncertainty.

sources.title: Targeting MLL-AF4 with short interfering RNAs inhibits clonogenicity and engraftment of t(4;11)-positive human leukemic cells
sources.inspected: Author-posted primary full-text Methods,Results,Fig1/3 captions; PDF mirror timed out; figure pixels not independently inspected
sources.adequacy: Best partial multi-design paired family: selected siMA6/siMARS plus wrong-breakpoint negative; all14-design parent panel unavailable.
sources.chemistry: Alnylam synthetic oligoribonucleotide strands, asymmetric lengths as printed; no full positional modification map.
sources.conditions: Fig1A,D,E:500 nM,electroporation,24 h;SEM(e9-e4) or RS4;11(e10-e4);GAPDH normalization.
sources.assay_specificity: Separate MLL-AF4,MLL,AF4 primer pairs printed. Fusion shares one primer with each parent assay; distinct paired primers, no independent remapping.
sources.negative_evidence: siMA3 knocks down AF4 (data not shown); siMA13 almost inactive; siMA6 wrong-breakpoint RS4;11 negative measured alongside both parents. Multiple breakpoints count as one family.
sources.numeric_availability: Figure-only; default>=3 independent experiments with3 replicates,SD; Fig1A explicitly one of2 similar experiments. No digitization; selected qualitative outcomes only.

sources.title: Inhibition of bcr-abl and/or c-abl gene expression by small interfering, double-stranded RNAs
sources.inspected: Indexed primary abstract/introduction only; direct full-text403
sources.adequacy: Cannot certify row-level adequacy; BCR-parent outcome not identified in inspected text.
sources.conditions: K562/Jurkat;single24 h and repeat6-day transfection;dose not inspected.
sources.negative_evidence: Two constructs active;third slight mRNA effect without protein effect; nonselective c-ABL suppression explicitly investigated.
sources.numeric_availability: Not extracted; full tables/figures not inspected.

sources.title: ASP210: a potent oligonucleotide-based inhibitor effective against TKI-resistant CML cells
sources.inspected: Main HTML Methods and relevant Results; schematic/plots not visually inspected
sources.adequacy: One linked design; no WT BCR/ABL paired readout in inspected assays. HL60 viability does not measure parents.
sources.chemistry: 34mer PS DNA;internal PEG12;5-prime Cyanine5 and3-prime biotin.
sources.conditions: 0.25/2.5 uM;MOLM7/CML-T1 resistant sublines;24 h and repeated dosing;no transfection reagent.
sources.negative_evidence: Multiple cells/doses are not independent designs; no failed junction-design panel.
sources.numeric_availability: Ct table present but not transcribed; no parent values.

sources.title: Masked antisense: a molecular configuration for discriminating similar RNA targets
sources.mechanism: expressed structured antisense RNA (separate from synthetic ASO)
sources.adequacy: Both endogenous parents measured but different modality,one selected masked antisense; not gapmer benchmark rows.
pointers: Expression vectors and HeLa cell transfections
sources.chemistry: U6/polIII vector-expressed dual-hairpin RNA;47nt complementarity;not chemically synthesized gapmer.
sources.conditions: HeLa;16 h;4 ug total plasmid;Superfect;fusion overexpression;n=9 transfections,SD for Fig4A.
sources.negative_evidence: p210 wrong isoform and Tal/empty vector controls;promoter interference noted.
sources.numeric_availability: Figures;not digitized;full sequence figure not transcribed.

sources.title: Inhibition of EWS-FLI-1 fusion protein with antisense oligodeoxynucleotides
sources.inspected: Primary abstract only;full paper not inspected
sources.adequacy: Screen exists;abstract measures fusion/EWS but does not establish FLI1 measurement;not counted.
sources.conditions: Cell-free RNaseH-dependent translation screen then selected ODN electroporated into TC32;dose/time uninspected.
sources.negative_evidence: Selection of fully inhibitory cell-free ODN before cellular study.

sources.title: Therapeutic potentialities of EWS-Fli-1 mRNA-targeted vectorized antisense oligonucleotides
sources.inspected: Primary abstract only;full paper not inspected
sources.adequacy: Two chemistries and controls;no both-parent outcomes identified in abstract;not counted.
sources.chemistry: PS and structured chimeric AON in nanoparticles;full sequence/modification map uninspected.
sources.negative_evidence: Control oligos and unvectorized comparisons do not establish full negative junction panel.

sources.title: BCR-ABL antisense oligodeoxyribonucleotides suppress the growth of leukemic and normal hematopoietic cells by a sequence-specific but nonantisense mechanism
sources.adequacy: Negative counterexample retained;no complete design/fusion/both-parent rows recovered.
sources.negative_evidence: Nonspecific or nonantisense growth inhibition reported;do not treat growth inhibition as fusion-specific cleavage.

sources.inspected: Repository metadata and indexed primary thesis excerpts pp110,113,119 only;PDF403
sources.adequacy: Unresolved strong lead,not certified: indexed p113 reports MLL,AF4,fusion RT-qPCR for PS/MOE/LNA candidates.
sources.chemistry: Indexed text:16mer LNA3-base wings and20mer MOE5-base wings;precise sequences/position maps uninspected.

sources.adequacy: Additional nonselective junction-siRNA counterexample;no IFITM10 parent readout established.
sources.negative_evidence: Junction-siRNA removes60kDa fusion band and also lowers canonical CTSD in DDX17/DDX5-depleted neuroblastoma context.
